subject: or_legislature/2025R1/HB3317
title: Requires a publicly traded corporation that makes a political expenditure of more than $100 in a calendar year to first obtain approval for the political expenditure from shareholders by an affirmative vote of the majority of shares entitled to vote.
headline: HB 3317 did not pass

claims.text: HB 3317 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
HB 3317 was still in a House committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
